name: PCMFlowUDP
description: UDP transport adapter for PCMFlow. Provides RawUdpSink / RawUdpStream for caller-defined payloads, VbanSender / VbanReceiver for VB-Audio Voicemeeter and VBAN Receptor interop (PCM subset of VBAN), and RtpSender / RtpReceiver for VoIP / WebRTC interop via standard RFC 3550 / 3551 / 7587 payload types (PCMU / PCMA / G722 / L16 / Opus). Codes against the Arduino UDP base class, so it works with WiFiUDP on ESP32 and on the lang-ship:host test target. No third-party vendored code; MIT.
keywords: audio, udp, vban, rtp, voicemeeter, voip, streaming, network, esp32, pcmflow
